convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iATR indicator. Simple entry/exit rules based on daily range vs ATR. Fixed lot sizing. No external libraries. No grid, martingale, or hedging logic.

derived_values.name: atr_range - ATR value converted to points
atr_rest - remaining range after trigger in points
day_range - current daily range in points
day_tohigh - distance from current ask to daily high in points
day_tolow - distance from current bid to daily low in points

other_exits: End-of-day close: OnTimer checks if sec_left < 0 (past midnight), closes any open position by ticket, and resets all flags for the next day

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Validates iLots against SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX, and SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP. If iLots does not align with volume_step, defaults to min_volume.

custom_logic_notes: Strategy: Breakout-style EA that waits for the daily price range to exceed a configurable percentage (perTrigger, default 60%) of the average daily ATR range. It determines trend direction by comparing distance-to-high vs distance-to-low: if day_tolow > day_tohigh, trend is UP (buy), otherwise DOWN (sell). On first tick, if the daily range already exceeds the trigger, the EA aborts. At end-of-day (timer-based), any open position is closed and all state is reset for the next trading day. SL is set at atr_trigger points from entry, TP at atr_rest points from entry, reflecting the asymmetrical split of the ATR range. The trade_opened flag prevents re-entry after the first trade each day even if the condition remains true on subsequent ticks.
python_conversion_notes: Intrabar signal behavior is repeat_while_true but gated by trade_opened flag, so effectively once per day. SL/TP are calculated as (atr_fraction * _Point) then normalized - in Python, compute ATR in price units directly rather than converting to/from points. The end-of-day timer reset logic must be replicated: close position at day boundary, reset flags. The margin check (free margin < 1000 * lots) should be adapted to the Python broker API equivalent. The range_reached flag on first_tick acts as a daily pre-filter that should be checked at session start.
